note: vehicle_bands covers all four vehicle groups; n_series_bands / band_list / bands keep their old three-rung meaning. A D-Max or F-series part is written with its own group and never as a rung of the N-series ladder.
outcome_note: `outcome` on the map row and `unresolved_outcome` on a part-number row say why a code carries no band. `pending_ruling` is currently empty - NMR and NMR85 were ruled onto the 5.5 t band on 2026-09-23 - but is kept because a future code can be parked.
